profile_notes: Sports & action bodies. GATE: require:[] — body specs (fps_electronic, af_low_light_ev) are sparse; a hard gate would empty the guide, so fit is axis-weighted. CRUX (dual, at 3): autofocus_body — subject/eye tracking hit-rate on erratic fast motion is the single biggest keeper-rate driver — and burst_buffer — frame rate + buffer depth to catch the peak of the action. These are co-equal for sports (unlike wildlife where AF edges ahead). SECONDARY at 2: sensor_performance (indoor arenas are dim + demand very fast shutter speeds → high-ISO headroom is decisive for sports specifically). SUPPORTING at 1: connectivity (fast wired/FTP image transfer off the sideline is a genuine SPORTS-PRESS differentiator — this is what separates this profile's fingerprint from wildlife), evf_lcd (low-blackout finder for tracking), build (weather/impact durability pitchside). Deliberately UNWEIGHTED (0/omitted): image_quality, video_capability, stabilization, battery_life, handling — real but not what separates sports-capable bodies. HONEST OVERLAP with wildlife (both are AF+burst disciplines — same physics); the profiles are distinguished by query intent + lexicon and by connectivity (sports/press) vs build+sensor field-weighting (wildlife).
